title: Launch Shipped
description:
Launch Shipped (shipped.anth.us): a community-ranked feed of AI that actually shipped. It pilots Papyrus collaborative steering (PPY-77bb3b) and the public knowledge base (PPY-428252).

Status 2026-10-22 12:00Z:
- Live and verified: the full design on every page, with remaining placeholders dimmed; 70 real items (30 decision models, 21 open TTS, 19 open LLMs) with sources, verdicts and AI-labelled scores; topic pages; the knowledge base (Trending, clusters, concept of the week, 282-page wiki stamped Edited by AI); agent-readable Markus twins, llms.txt, Accept negotiation and page actions; reader components (vote, used-it, ratings, comments, submit, sign-in); newsletter signup; the content policies page; the wide-display layout; lime chrome; deploy-on-merge through Actions → OIDC → Amplify.
- Blocked on Ryan: Google redirect URIs (ship-63b07d), which gate every reader write.
- In progress: the newsletter confirm-page fix (email lead), then Ryan's inbox retest; 6 designer items; the ranked-list island for Rising; making the Person-ID scan a CI gate.
Delivery rule: deploy incrementally; the full design always visible; placeholders dimmed (~60%) with a label until real.

comments.text: 2026-10-22: Repositioning decided with the product owner. Shipped moves from a verdict board to a living map with three layers (signals, the map, AI-written stories), steered by signed-in readers, with an editor tier that can override them. Tagline: "In the wild, and mapped as it moves." Planned as three epics: ship-573e70 (vocabulary, statuses, dimensions; site only; do before sign-in opens), ship-f4cd69 (page layouts from the round-3 design) and ship-054405 (engine-backed features).
